name: Bruno Gustavo da Silva
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Brazilian flyweight from American Top Team (age 36) on a 1-4 run in the UFC: stopped by Manel Kape (R3, 2024) and Joshua Van (R3, 2025), a R3 submission of Hyun Sung Park (October 2025), a split-decision loss to Charles Johnson (March 2026) and a R1 submission loss to Edgar Chairez (June). Our records merge him with other Bruno Silvas, so only his UFC fights are used here.

how_they_fight.Striking: A power puncher by reputation, with most of his career finishes by knockout.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Can wrestle; has been submitted (Chairez, R1).
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped in three of his last five fights.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Two of his recent stoppage losses came late (R3).

concerns: 1-4 in his last five UFC fights

sources.author: Mike Heck
